cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Take the Consequence
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility for carrying out the cost, penalty, or unpleasant next step.

mechanism: Copy a rejection mark as approval, then transfer the unpleasant announcement onto the colleague whose marking was misunderstood.
confusable: Not simply shifting blame after understanding figures: B2 must disclose the copied cross-out and A3 must treat it as an understood revision.
comparison: Shared office announcement versus a household loss penalty.
seedUse: Retains budget-cut announcement and responsibility bargain; newly supplies a misunderstood signature/cross-out cause.
